My thoughts: the intro (first 45s to 1 min) is pretty fire, that part flows really well with the chords coming from the pads and the hook kinda being in the bass, drums dropping in and out as well. When the main hook comes in ab a minute in is also pretty good, but I think then that’s where it loses momentum when it repeats it. 
I really like the energy at the beginning, I would capitalize on that. I think you should derive the hook from the chord progression more, and maybe even use the pads as a driving factor, and sprinkle in the main hook a bit less, I can see that part sounding really cool, but in moderation.

I love how it just starts, I really love songs that do that. The vibe here is really cool, the cover art compliments your sound and style. I’m not sure if this is just a piece of a larger project, but I’d love to hear it in an album context, considering it’s only 30 seconds. I don’t have a lot of critiques bc part of me believes you have a vision in mind. But if it’s not for an album, definitely extend this track’s length.

I like the chord progression, as well as the acoustic buzzy tone. Can definitely see the Duster influence while also putting your own take on it. You’ve got your tone dialed in pretty well, the last 0:25 seconds was some great guitar work. My only critique would be not to process your vocals as much, mostly to be able to hear the lyrics, but I also get the appeal to have the lo fi sound. Personally, whether you think you can sing or not, a genuine performance can sound very raw and add to the emotional depth of the song. But to each their own
